<ParamField body="children" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt;[]" required>
  Complete ordered list of elements, each with a stable key. The popup contains only items that do not fit in the compact row.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="defaultOpen" type="boolean" default="false">
  Initial popup visibility when uncontrolled. Defaults to false.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="maxInlineCount" type="number">
  Maximum number of items visible in the compact row. Available width can reduce this count further. Remaining items belong to the popup.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onOpenChange" type="((open: boolean, eventDetails: PopoverRootChangeEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Receives the requested open state and unchanged Base UI event details, including reason, event, trigger, cancel() and preventUnmountOnClose().
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="open" type="boolean">
  Controlled popup visibility. A popup can appear only when items overflow and showOverflowCount is not false.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="overflowLabel" type="string" default="Show hidden items">
  Accessible label for the popup. The default overflow button is named by its visible count followed by this label. Defaults to Show hidden items.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="popupProps" type="Omit&lt;PopoverPopupProps, &quot;children&quot;&gt;">
  Popover.Popup native props, handlers, ref, render composition and focus options for the overflow content.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;">
  Ref forwarded to the compact row root div.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="showOverflowCount" type="boolean">
  Shows the count on hover, keyboard focus or while open by default. Use true to keep it visible whenever items overflow, or false to clip the row without a trigger or exposed popup. Empty lists and lists that fit have no trigger.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="triggerProps" type="Omit&lt;
